newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dacom to set up system integration unit.
newsitem.headline: Dacom to set up system integration unit.

text.p: South Korea's Dacom Corp said on Monday it will spin off its computer systems integration division into a wholly owned subsidiary in December.
The company said in a statement Dacom System Technologies (DST) will offer computer solutions such as network management systems and computerisation of administrative functions.
The telephone service provider said DST is expected to see sales of 85 billion won during its first year of business, rising to one trillion won by 2002.
DST will have an initial capitalisation of 10 billion won, Dacom said. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
